blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — A people’s summit highlighted community-driven campaigns for sustainable farming and rural enterprise that were turned into municipal legislation. The two-day 6th Sibagat People’s Summit was held on Oct. 30-31 in Sibagat, Agusan del Sur, where civil society organizations (CSOs), sectoral leaders, Indigenous Peoples’ representatives, and municipal executives met to integrate grassroots development agendas directly into local governance. Speaking on behalf of Mayor Dr. Thelma Lamanilao, executive assistant Ruby Laid urged residents and bureaucrats alike to move beyond habitual complaints and assume shared responsibility for the town’s progress.
